From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Subject: Surface risk deck + stage cleanse — immediate updates requested

Team —

Quick one. Finance needs a clean set of numbers for our forecast lock today (close of business PT). I attached a single-sheet pipe-sufficiency workbook that highlights deals > $50k across stages. Please do the following by 17:00 PT: 

- Confirm that each deal you own has the correct stage (Proposal, Commit, Commit-At-Risk, Commit-Confirmed).
- Add a numeric confidence signal (1-5) in the new "Signal" column and a one-line justification in "Note" for any change.
- For any deal moving out of Commit -> Opposed stages, mark the expected shortfall amount in the "Delta" column.

Key asks: we need a realistic commit number (not wishful). If a customer has said yes but legal/PO is pending, keep it in Commit-At-Risk and note the blocker.

I've flagged Acme Corp (HS-5239) as a concern — Rishi, please confirm if the verbal buy still maps to our Commit bucket or if we should mark as At-Risk.

Attachments: pipe-sufficiency-sheet-20260930.xlsx (single source of truth)

Thanks — this will feed the finance lock and the VP sketch for Friday.

— Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
